content:
julian: Heads-up — ACME POC kickoff. Need to lock scope + success criteria so we can send SOW + price ranges. Primary ask: doc summarization (extraction + Q&A) for knowledge base. They want a 2‑week POC, deliverables include eval report and a runbook for production rollout. 

alex: Got it. For scope we should define: 1) dataset (10k articles subset?), 2) prompt templates, 3) eval metrics (ROUGE/F1 + factuality checks + latency under 300ms p50). Also confirm whether they want hosted or dedicated for the POC. 

julian: ACME prefers hosted initially but will evaluate Dedicated if latency/cost reqs met. Price sensitivity: they asked for an estimate for hosted for 2 weeks ~ 50M tokens. Can we ballpark? 

maya: Ballpark hosted token cost depends on model variant. For an LLM-16k quantized variant: rough cost = $0.0006/token => 50M tokens ~ $30k. With caching/batching optimizations probably 30-40% savings. Add eval-engine time ~ a few hundred USD. We should present a tiered quote (hosted baseline, dedicated estimate if committed throughput). 

derek: For success criteria on quality, propose: 
- Golden set: 300 gold Q&A pairs (mix of fact lookup and abstractive answers).
- Pass threshold: >85% exact-match on extraction tasks, >0.7 BLEU/ROUGE for abstractive, and <2% hallucination on targeted checks.
- Performance: p50 <300ms, p95 <700ms on their sample load.

alex: For the eval harness I'll spin up a reproducible pipeline. Plan: use our eval-runner with these stages:
1) normalize outputs (strip metadata)
2) compute metrics (EM, ROUGE, entailment via NLI model)
3) regression gates that fail the run if any metric drops >5% vs baseline

maya: Sample eval config (for the thread):
```
{
  "dataset": "acme_kb_300_gold.jsonl",
  "metrics": ["exact_match","rouge_l","nli_entailment"],
  "regression_gate": {"threshold_pct": 5, "monitored_metrics": ["exact_match","nli_entailment"]},
  "warmup_samples": 50
}
```
Note: we'll version the prompt templates and store them alongside the golden set. 

julian: Timeline check — customer expects POC in 2 weeks. Is that realistic for dataset prep + harness + run? 

derek: Tight but doable if ACME provides initial dataset slice (2k docs) and product SME sits with us for initial prompt curation. Week 1: dataset + prompt design + baseline runs. Week 2: iterative tuning + final eval + report. 

sasha: Security checklist: started the security questionnaire yesterday. We can answer most SaaS questions (encryption, RBAC, logging). Open items: they require on-prem key controls (HSM) for production — POC can use hosted KMS but flag it as an enterprise blocker. ETA to finish questionnaire: EOD Friday. cc @sec-bot for automated scan. :lock:

sec-bot: Vulnerability scan for the proposed POC infra completed: no critical findings. Generating artifact: https://internal.ci/reports/scan-1751839200 

alex: Action items I have: 1) template eval config + runner script, 2) generate 300-gold template + sampling guide, 3) draft hosted vs dedicated quote. I’ll drop the draft SOW by tomorrow. 

julian: Great — I'll send a partner ask to ACME to get the 2k doc slice and SME availability. Also I'll flag the HSM requirement as potential enterprise blocker in the executive summary. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
